annotations.title: Read tourism figures of an Italian comune

description: Reads the tourism figures of one Italian municipality (comune) in one year: nights spent (presenze), arrivals, bed places, accommodation establishments and resident population. Use it when you have the 6-digit `cod_istat` from cerca_comune; do not use it to look a place up by name (use cerca_comune instead), to follow a comune over the years (use leggi_serie_comune instead) or to put comuni side by side (use confronta_comuni instead). Presenze are nights, not people (one guest staying three nights counts three); `anno` defaults to the latest year with data, and capacity figures are for `anno_capacita`: the latest year published, as on the comune's page, or the latest up to `anno` when `anno` is given; `profilo` adds the comune's altitude, surface, coordinates, UNESCO sites and tourism pressure, each group with its own year. Missing figures are null and `nota` says why (also from 2025, when the counts changed scope, and when `profilo` is null), and a year outside `anni_disponibili` or an unknown code returns an error that says what to pass. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

anno.description: Year of the figures, e.g. 2024; default: the latest year with data for this comune. A year outside its years with data returns an error that gives them.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune as a string, leading zeros kept ("058091" is Roma); it comes from cerca_comune.

name: leggi_dati_comune

anni_disponibili.description: First and last year with movement figures for this comune, the accepted range of `anno`; null if the comune has none.

ultimo.description: Latest year with movement figures, the default `anno`.

anno.description: Year of the movement figures (presenze and arrivi): `anno_richiesto`, or the latest year with data when it was omitted; null if the comune has no tourism data.

anno_capacita.description: Year of the capacity figures (bed places and establishments): with `anno`, the latest year published up to it; without, the latest year published, as on the comune's page. It can be earlier or later than `anno`, and `nota` then gives both years; null if none is published.

anno_richiesto.description: The `anno` argument as given; null when it was omitted.

arrivi_italiani.description: Arrivals of guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_stranieri.description: Arrivals of guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_totali.description: Guest arrivals (check-ins) at accommodation establishments during `anno`; null if not available.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

esercizi.description: Number of accommodation establishments in `anno_capacita`; null if not available.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Notes in English on reading the figures, null when there is nothing to say: from 2025 ISTAT counts include privately rented holiday flats, so totals and non-hotel figures are not comparable with years before 2025 (hotel figures are); capacity from a year other than `anno`; a year or a comune without movement figures; a comune without a `profilo`.

popolazione.description: Resident population in `popolazione_anno` (the latest year loaded, whatever `anno` is); null if not available.

popolazione_anno.description: Reference year of `popolazione`; null if not available.

posti_letto.description: Bed places in accommodation establishments in `anno_capacita`: the ISTAT total, or hotel plus non-hotel beds where the total is missing, as on the site; null if not available.

presenze_italiani.description: Nights spent by guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_stranieri.description: Nights spent by guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_totali.description: Nights spent by all guests in accommodation establishments during `anno` (one guest staying three nights counts three); null if not available.

profilo.description: The comune's territorial profile, the same data as the Territorial profile section of its page: altitude, surface, coordinates, UNESCO World Heritage sites and two tourism-pressure ratios, with the year of each group in `anni` and its own `fonte`. Null when no profile is recorded for the comune or this server does not serve it; `nota` then says which.

altitudine_m.description: Altitude of the comune's centre in metres above sea level (ISTAT); null if not available.

anni.description: The reference year of each group of the profile, only of what was used; null where the group is not available.

classificazioni.description: Reference year of the ISTAT group (`altitudine_m`, `superficie_kmq` and the classifications): the year the file refers to; null if that group is not available.

popolazione.description: Reference year of the resident population used in `presenze_per_abitante`: the year closest to `anni.presenze`, which can differ from it; null if that group is not available.

posti_letto.description: Reference year of the bed places used in `posti_letto_per_kmq`: the latest year of the accommodation establishments; null if that group is not available.

presenze.description: Reference year of the nights spent used in `presenze_per_abitante`: the latest year with movement figures; null if that group is not available.

wikidata.description: Reference year of the Wikidata group (`lat`, `lon`, `siti_unesco`): the year read; null if that group is not available.

fonte.description: Sources to cite with the profile: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT) and Wikidata (CC0).

grado_urbanizzazione.description: Degree of urbanisation (ISTAT): 1 city, 2 towns and suburbs, 3 rural areas; null if not available.

isolano.description: True if the comune is on an island, false if not (ISTAT); null if not available.

lat.description: Latitude of the comune in degrees (Wikidata, WGS 84); null if not available, including the few comuni with two different points, none of which is chosen.

litoraneo.description: True if the comune is on the coast, false if not (ISTAT); null if not available.

lon.description: Longitude of the comune in degrees (Wikidata, WGS 84); null when `lat` is null.

montano.description: Mountain classification of the comune (ISTAT): T entirely mountain, P partly mountain, NM not mountain; null if not available.

posti_letto_per_kmq.description: Bed places in the latest year of the accommodation establishments (`anni.posti_letto`) per square kilometre of `superficie_kmq`, rounded to two decimals; null if a term is missing.

presenze_per_abitante.description: Tourism pressure: nights spent in the latest year with movement figures (`anni.presenze`) per resident (population of `anni.popolazione`), rounded to two decimals; null if a term is missing. Nights are not people.

siti_unesco.description: Number of UNESCO World Heritage sites located in the comune (Wikidata), a count taken from Wikidata as it is; 0 if none; null if the comune is not in Wikidata.

superficie_kmq.description: Surface area of the comune in square kilometres (ISTAT); null if not available.

zona_altimetrica.description: Altimetric zone of the comune (ISTAT): 1 inland mountain, 2 coastal mountain, 3 inland hill, 4 coastal hill, 5 plain; null if not available.

provincia.description: Province (or metropolitan city) as recorded by ISTAT; null if not recorded.

regione.description: Region as recorded by ISTAT (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

scheda.description: Link to the comune's public page on datituristici.it, to cite.

title: Read tourism figures of an Italian comune
